# JayJay Diff

> JayJay Diff reviews any public GitHub pull request, comparison, or commit in the browser, with review marks that survive force-pushes.

Each hunk has a stable review identity, fingerprinted from its content and nearby context, so after a rebase only the hunks that changed come back for review. Marks and notes stay in the reader's browser. Signing in with GitHub is optional; it raises the rate limit and can sync marks with GitHub's Viewed boxes.

## Open a review

Swap `github.com` for `diff.hewig.dev` in a GitHub URL, or paste the URL on the home page.

- Pull request: `https://diff.hewig.dev/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<number>`
- One commit of a pull request: `https://diff.hewig.dev/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<number>/commits/<sha>`
- Comparison: `https://diff.hewig.dev/<owner>/<repo>/compare/<base>...<head>`
- Commit: `https://diff.hewig.dev/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<sha>`

Only public repositories open. The pages render in the browser from JavaScript.
